Marion (Finance): Heads-up 1K invoice from 'DataAlly CH' (INV-DA-2024-11) shows 8% CH VAT but we were expecting 0% cross-border. Vendor billed Swiss VAT on a Netherlands customer entity. Putting payment on hold. cc @Felix Tax @Ana Legal
InvoiceBot: Invoice INV-DA-2024-11 uploaded by @DataAlly CH total: 


 12,600 (VAT 8% = 960). File: invoice_DA_2024_11.pdf
Felix Tax: Quick note: Switzerland is non-EU so place-of-supply rules differ. For B2B (NL VAT-registered buyer) the Swiss supplier should normally zero-rate exports if proof of export exists; charging Swiss VAT suggests they treated buyer as domestic. Need: 1) supplier Swiss UID, 2) proof of export (transport evidence or commercial docs), 3) buyer VAT number on invoice and buyer confirmation that they're B2B (VAT reg). If supplier can't prove export, VAT may be due.
Ana Legal: Also check contract and who bears taxes per T&C. If buyer provided NL VAT ID at time of sale, seller should not charge Swiss VAT on exported services to EU B2B in many cases. Request reissued invoice showing 0% VAT or a refund + explanation. If they remit VAT to Swiss authorities already, we need their Swiss VAT return excerpt showing invoice ID to reconcile reclaim.
Johan (APAC Ops): Vendor replied quickly: they say Swiss branch auto-applied VAT based on billing address and attach Swiss UID CHE-123.456.789 MWST and a screenshot of their billing engine. They say they didnt receive NL VAT ID on checkout.
Felix Tax: Action: Run UID validation (swiss admin portal) and ask vendor for evidence of export/delivery to NL (signed delivery/contract, SWIFT payout showing invoiced party, or a signed statement). Also require reissued invoice containing our NL VAT: NL999888777B01 and text: "Export of services  0% VAT (proof attached)" or a full refund of the VAT element.
Marion (Finance): Putting INV-DA-2024-11 on hold. SLA to vendor: 5 business days to supply either (a) reissued 0% invoice including buyer VAT + export proof, or (b) refund proof of CHF 960. Logging in refunds tracker.
Ana Legal: Suggested vendor copy to send: "Please reissue INV-DA-2024-11 without Swiss VAT and include the buyer VAT number NL999888777B01. Alternatively, refund the VAT amount of CHF 960 and provide evidence of VAT remittance if already filed. Attach export proof (contract, export declaration, or commercial transport documentation)."
InvoiceBot: Hold created: PH-213456-01 for INV-DA-2024-11
Felix Tax: FYI Swiss UID CHE-123.456.789 returned as ACTIVE (checked on CHE admin). If they provide export proof and reissue invoice we can clear hold. If they remit and cannot refund, we may request their VAT return excerpt for reclaim but thats friction.
Marion (Finance): Thanks all. I'll wait for vendor docs and only process credit/refund once corrected invoice or bank/refund proof is attached. Closing when bank feed reconciles. :white_check_mark:
